verdict.rationale: Twenty's docs explicitly support custom objects with 20+ field types, relations between any objects including many-to-many, and first-class treatment for custom objects (API endpoints, views, permissions, workflow triggers). A Metadata API allows programmatic schema changes, and the CLI lets developers define objects, fields and views as code. A community comment calls the customization promising but describes the product as alpha with small issues, so it neither strongly corroborates nor contradicts this. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of custom-object and relationship modeling in practice.
